title: ThinkSuit Turn Request
description: The surface contract for what a caller may send to start a single turn. Names, not resolved objects; no secrets or runtime handles.

input.description: User input text for the turn

sessionId.description: Session ID to resume or create

plan.description: Plan name to use from the plans library

frame.description: Frame name to use from the frames library

modality.description: Modality name (e.g. 'voice'); the module renders it into the prelude

tools.description: Allow-list of tool names (empty or omitted means all tools allowed)

workdir.description: Owned home-base root directory (absolute path). Set when the session is created and immutable for the session's lifetime; a later turn passing a different workdir is rejected. Declares space you own — it does not restrict where the agent may operate (that is allowedDirectories). Defaults cwd and allowedDirectories.

cwd.description: Working directory for this turn (absolute path) — where the tools run and what the agent is told it is working in. Caller-owned; defaults to workdir when omitted.

allowedDirectories.description: Directory paths the tools may access (absolute)

autoApproveTools.description: Auto-approve tool calls instead of prompting
